heading.text: Spices that remember where they came from.

findings.message: 10 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 13 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "The pantry · 30 jars & sets" above "THE MASALA dabba, SORTED."; "Jar of the month · Kesar" above "GOLD,"; "Combos & bundles" above "BETTER"; "+1" (pill) above "Tadka Starter Kit"; "Save ₹347" (pill) above "Biryani Night Box"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 28 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Free shipping above ₹499", "Cash on delivery available", "No preservatives. Ever.", "Stone-ground in Indore · 100% fresh").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ★
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): div.arch-stripes → repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(240, 180, 41) 0px, rgb(240, 180, 41) 46px, rgb(232, 166, 36) 46px, rgb(23 | div.aisle-veil → linear-gradient(rgba(36, 17, 9, 0.85), rgba(36, 17, 9, 0) 38%, rgba(36, 17, 9, 0) 70%, rgba(36, 17, 9, 0.7)) | div.awning.rev-aw → repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(198, 42, 31) 0px, rgb(198, 42, 31) 28px, rgb(242, 178, 48) 28px, rgb(242,
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.stamp.stamp-sm → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 0px 10px 30px -10px, rgba(251, 244, 232, 0.18) 0px 0px 0px 3p | div.aisle-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0px 24px 50px -20px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 4 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.nav.wrap 1272px | div.facts 602px | section.trust 1440px | div.wrap.legal 1272px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 15 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (8 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #f3e8d6, section #f3e8d6, section #fbf4e8).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Combos & bundles" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (DM Sans, Instrument Serif, Anton).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 37 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("OPEN THE dabba.") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (108px, 127px, 438px, 549px, 749px, 902px, 963px); the three most used hold only 42% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "OPEN THE" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "HALDI" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "JEERA" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "MIRCH" (screen 3, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "WALK THE aisle." (screen 10, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "WALK THE aisle."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Free shipping above" (11px from the left); "Cash on delivery available" (11px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
